acceptanceScopes.gn1: Four platform initial geometries, sprites and distinct shapes after two process frames; does not simulate player triggers or fall timing.
acceptanceScopes.city: 66 related checker assertions covering initialization, 120 idle process calls, 15 models forward/backward, wrapping, key cancellation and rotation. Not 66 independent model trials or full gameplay.
acceptanceScopes.mob: Three seeded Mob initializations checking upright orientation, zero vertical velocity and declared horizontal speed range; no full gameplay or random-distribution proof.

optimizationDecision.bottleneck: Extra Root model work after the first GN-1 edit; equivalent-fix reconsideration and repeated final-candidate validation.
optimizationDecision.telemetryEvidence: GN-1 Single/Adaptive Host 157168/268429 ms; Root requests 21/36; Root request elapsed sums 139664.022581/244639.2166529999 ms; team lock wait 50.466587000046275 ms. Post-edit phase 52.406/137.541 s. First Multi fix showed four distinct correct-size shapes after correcting a query identifier; Root then switched from script duplication to resource_local_to_scene and validated again. Only final candidates received independent acceptance, all 2/2 passed.
optimizationDecision.change: Add one Root stop/reopen rule: finish a minimally fixed candidate after relevant validation; require an observed failure, concrete uncovered requirement, conflicting evidence or later source change before revisiting an equivalent fix or repeating validation. A worker alternative alone does not reopen the validated candidate. Existing boundaries and validation uncertainty remain.
optimizationDecision.hypothesis: Reduce unnecessary post-edit Root requests; no guaranteed speedup or causal attribution of the first-run delay to the worker.
optimizationDecision.reasonForVerification: One fresh Single/Adaptive attempt per development case to measure this single targeted change. Both original outcomes remain reported. No additional tuning after this phase.
optimizationDecision.holdout: Mob Orientation, one Single and one Adaptive only after this verification.

rootWorkSubstitution.interpretation: Root performed the same core source investigation and same number of game queries as Single, then additionally waited for worker findings. The reported diagnosis was correct but did not observably substitute for Root work.

criticalPathEvidence.interpretation: Largest extra interval is before first edit, with additional Root requests and wait time. Final game validation duration is nearly equal, and measured lock wait is negligible relative to the wall difference.

workerTail.cancellation: Explicit Root interrupt_agent after final Root game verification
workerTail.tailWork: Continued searching source and checking lines, stopped baseline execution, launched another execution on the shared edited candidate, queried mobs, reviewed diff and sent a second no-more-changes-needed message. Parent assignment was read-only code investigation.
workerTail.interpretation: No keepalive wait was observed, but the worker did not finish promptly and instead extended investigation/verification until interrupted; duplicated post-edit evidence did not remove Root final checks.

targetedPolicyScope.note: This holdout exposed a remaining delegation/duplication problem after the single allowed post-edit optimization; result retained without further tuning.
